text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening sentence","quality":"position statement","description":"It states a definite stance early so the reader immediately knows the essay’s argument."},{"evidence":"three-part benefits paragraph on safety, disabilities, and productivity","quality":"idea development","description":"It develops several distinct reasons with explanations instead of repeating one simple point."},{"evidence":"reference to car accidents, drunk driving, disabilities, and transport workers","quality":"use of supporting details","description":"It draws on multiple concrete ideas to support its claims rather than relying on a single general assertion."},{"evidence":"intro, body, and conclusion present","quality":"essay structure","description":"It has a more complete argumentative organization with a clear beginning, middle, and ending."},{"evidence":"“As stated in the article” and article-based claims","quality":"text integration","description":"It more clearly connects its argument to the source article and incorporates information from it."}]}
